prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0004",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 56,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01281-01282",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "なるほどねぇ",
      "en": "I see..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01284-01285",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "リンシャはゆっくりと頷くと、\n俺の背中を軽く肘で突いてから、厨房へと歩いていった。",
      "en": "Rinsha nodded slowly, then lightly elbowed my back and walked off to the kitchen."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01291-01292",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "？",
      "en": "Huh?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01299-01299",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "程なくして、リンシャが料理を三人分持って戻って来た。",
      "en": "Soon, Rinsha returned, carrying food for three."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01301-01302",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "あたしも食事まだなのよ、一緒に食べていい？",
      "en": "I haven't eaten yet either. Mind if I join you?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01304-01304",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "そう言いながら既にテーブルの上に三人分の料理を並べている。",
      "en": "With that, she was already setting the table for three."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01306-01307",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "ああ",
      "en": "Sure."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01309-01310",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ありがと",
      "en": "Thanks."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01312-01314",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺の答えと同時に小気味よい笑みを浮かべながら\n正面の席に座ったリンシャは、\n矢継ぎ早に質問を浴びせてきた……",
      "en": "As I answered, Rinsha seated herself across from me with a cheerful smile and immediately launched into a rapid-fire barrage of questions..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01316-01317",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "それで二人はこの街に何をしに来たの？",
      "en": "So, what brings you two to this town?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01319-01320",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "療養だ",
      "en": "Recuperation."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01322-01324",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "あら、でもさっきうちの前でレヴィアと\n話していたじゃない？",
      "en": "Oh? But I saw you talking with Levia\nout front earlier, didn't you?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01326-01327",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "レヴィアは、よく此処に来るのか？",
      "en": "Does Levia come here often?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01329-01330",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ええ、最近じゃお得意様よ、て、やっぱり……",
      "en": "Yes, she's a regular lately... And... I thought so..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01332-01333",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "何がだ？",
      "en": "What do you mean?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01335-01336",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "何時まで立っても来ない男って、セリカの事だったんだ",
      "en": "So the guy who never showed up, no matter how long she waited... that was you, Celica."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01338-01339",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "レヴィアが言っていたのか？",
      "en": "Did Levia say that?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01341-01342",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ええ、任務を何だと思っているんだ、て怒っていたわよ",
      "en": "Yes, she was angry, saying 'What do you think the mission is?'"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01344-01345",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "それはさっき言われた",
      "en": "She just told me that."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01347-01347",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "リンシャが楽しそうに笑う。",
      "en": "Rinsha laughed cheerfully."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01349-01350",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "で、セリカも人捜しに来たんでしょ",
      "en": "So, Celica, you came looking for someone too, right?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01352-01353",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "半分は療養のつもりだ",
      "en": "Half of it is for recuperation."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01355-01357",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "あら、真面目じゃないのね、\nレヴィアはあんなに頑張っているのに",
      "en": "Oh, so you're not taking it seriously?\nEven though Levia is working so hard..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01359-01360",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "そうだな",
      "en": "True."
    }
  ]
}
